payload.note: ball comes down on the near (HND) court's right sideline, the dark line under the right antenna; at the contact frame (60 fps) the ball sits on the line, so the contact patch touches it. Margin = half the 5 cm line width (ball centred on the line); sigma is our pixel read (~1 px = 1 cm at that spot, blur ~3 px). The overlay gives AZM the point (AZM 10 -> 11), consistent with 'in'.
